'''Kalist VI''', also known simply as '''Kalist''', was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Dak Ralter/Legends|Dak Ralter]].

==Description==
Kalist VI was a bleak, mountainous, desert planet, home to an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Kalist Base|base and labor colony]]. The planet's air was drier and cleaner than the fetid air of [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]], but not as unpleasantly acrid as [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]].<ref name="TWSotW1" />

==History==
The labor colony was home to many prisoners of the Empire, including [[Politics/Legends|political]] prisoners and prisoners of war. The [[Dak Ralter's parents|parents]] of [[Dak Ralter/Legends|Dak Ralter]] were imprisoned on Kalist VI since the early days of the New Order, and Ralter himself was born into captivity there. The complex itself consisted of a massive [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] dome, with a landing pad and several power fences around the perimeter. Shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Ralter and a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] prisoner named [[Breg]] used a stolen [[Imperial prison barge]] to escape from Kalist VI.<ref name="GG3" />

[[File:KalistVI.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The [[Kalist Base]].]]

Approximately eight months after the Battle of Yavin the Empire took [[Jabiimi]] prisoners, as well as [[Jorin Sol]], to the base where the Jabiimi were used for slave labor. An imperial officer called [[Zuud]] tortured Sol for information regarding the location of the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]]. A Rebel team including [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] successfully [[Battle of Kalist VI|infiltrated]] the base posing as the crew of the Imperial tanker ''[[Nuna's Twins]]'', with the intention of retrieving Sol. Luring most of the base's troops off-planet and into a [[Ambush at Thila|trap]], the Rebels rescued Sol and the prisoners, causing heavy damage to the base. After the attack the base was repaired and reinforced suspiciously quickly.<ref name="TWSotW" />

After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Kalist came under the authority of the [[Zero Command]], an Imperial faction established by [[Lord High Admiral]] [[Blitzer Harrsk]].<ref name="TEA" />
